items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet has already been ruled out with a knee injury (carted off during TNF).
items.why: Knee injury; carted, thumbs up but ruled out.
items.implication: Full TE1 role shift to Loveland immediately.
items.opportunity: Colston Loveland snaps/routes/targets spike; already seeing projected usage.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and will be listed as limited.
items.why: Left practice early; calf issue amid Adams absence and delayed Ferguson return.
items.implication: Monitor Friday/Saturday reports; high target share at risk if limited or out.
items.opportunity: Increased TE or secondary WR usage if misses time; prior Levitan 25-tgt projection assumes health.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially did not practice for a second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Elevated OUT risk for Week 7; monitor activation.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and other KC WRs/TE see expanded routes/targets if inactive.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice (Jets injury report).
items.implication: Positive for availability; monitor full participation.
items.opportunity: If active, primary RB role resumes.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medicals (non-football); MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers amid OL mess. Long-term Jacobs outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access positive signal; backups inefficient EPA.
items.implication: Jacobs RB1 pathway when cleared; fade Lloyd/Johnson handcuffs short-term.
items.opportunity: Jacobs workload resumption; poor backup efficiency supports full role.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice (Ravens).
items.why: On field for practice start post-hamstring.
items.implication: Progress toward return; still monitor designation.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is in-line to play vs DAL on MNF (ranks RB15); efficient in full games played; Dallas strong RB fantasy matchup.
items.opportunity: Full workload likely vs soft DAL run D.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role with high target share/routes vs soft Bears pass D allowing high YPA.
items.why: 33% target share, 97% routes Week 6 despite drops; Bears soft secondary.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low-scoring issues), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D), Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-layoff), Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot).
items.why: Nasty matchups, role/volume concerns, inefficiency or layoff.
items.implication: Sit or fade in Week 7 lineups.
items.conflict: Jacobs facility access positive per Levitan vs Berry fade.

items.text: Drake Maye shoo-in top-5 QB1 vs Bears (soft pass D, missing ends/Edwards); Rhamondre Stevenson 60% snaps/14 touches expected similar or bigger (blitz protection); Henderson ankle not 100%/fumble risk.
items.why: Bears 2nd-most YPA allowed; Maye hot streak; Stevenson trusted vs blitz.
items.implication: Maye QB1 lock; Stevenson RB2/flex; fade Henderson.
items.opportunity: High total game; Stevenson pass-pro + carries; Maye rushing upside.

items.text: With Terrance Ferguson recovery delayed beyond IR eligibility and Davante Adams out, Rams' only answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson not ready soon per Schefter source; Adams long-term hamstring.
items.implication: Puka elite WR1 volume ROS/weekly even with calf scare.
items.opportunity: Massive target monopoly; TE target share secondary.
items.conflict: Calf practice exit creates short-term uncertainty vs projection.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS value/landing spot uncertainty; monitor deadline.
items.opportunity: If traded to better situation, usage upgrade possible.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (elite volume), Tucker Kraft @ DET (Lions pass D gift), Jaylen Warren @ NO (workload + friendly matchup).
items.why: Smith volume; Kraft/Warren vs soft defenses allowing big production to pass-catchers/RBs.

items.text: JJ McCarthy starting for Giants vs Houston; historical YPT to Justin Jefferson only 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, etc). Different scheme/coaches/small sample but concerning.
items.why: Low YPT sample with McCarthy; scheme shift.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency/volume risk in short term.
items.opportunity: Monitor early chemistry; possible WR target redistribution.
